title: Clarify invoke-envelope semantics, coalesce stream fragments, and disambiguate choice resolution
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Improves OpenAI tool/function invoke compatibility: stable framed invoke-envelope for streaming, clearer tool_choice semantics, and safer fallback behavior for fragmented tool messages. No breaking API changes for callers.
body: Motivation: customer signals and internal e2e runs exposed two pain points in the OpenAI compatibility layer when using function/tool calling over streaming: 1) streaming fragments could split the logical invoke envelope (tool invocation metadata + schema) across multiple events and cause downstream resolvers to misidentify tool_choice decisions; 2) semantics around tool_choice were underspecified when multiple candidate tools share overlapping schemas, leading to non-deterministic selection under load. This PR: introduces a compact invoke-envelope wrapper that is emitted as a single logical unit over the stream whenever possible and provides deterministic heuristics for resolving tool_choice when schemas overlap; coalesces adjacent fragmented stream frames that belong to the same logical invoke to reduce parser churn; adds explicit diagnostic counters and traces for envelope reassembly; updates the Python SDK tests and docs with examples of the new envelope and fallback rules. Changeset summary: implement invoke_envelope framing and reassembly in openai_compat layer; extract choice resolver with deterministic priority and schema-conflict tie-breaker; improve stream parser to merge contiguous fragments annotated with same-invoke-id; add unit + integration tests that simulate interleaved fragmented frames and racey dispatch; add doc section 'Invoke envelope and choice resolution' with examples and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] Implement envelope framing and parsing - [x] Resolve schema overlap deterministically - [x] Add tests (unit + integration) - [x] Add docs and migration notes - [x] Run full e2e against hosted/replica harness Impact: lowers incidence of misrouted tool invocations in streaming sessions and reduces spurious duplicate invocations under intermittent fragmentation. No consumer-visible API changes: existing openai-compat endpoints accept the same payloads, but streaming sessions will be more robust. See linked Linear ENG-4982 for rollout plan.
commits: implement: add invoke_envelope framing and parser (openai_compat)
refactor: extract choice_resolver with deterministic schema conflict handling
improve: coalesce fragmented stream frames in parser and add traces
test: add interleaved fragmentation integration tests
docs: add invoke-envelope and choice-resolution migration notes
